sections.heading: MCC counseling upload standards.
body: During MCC All India Quota (AIQ) and State Medical Counseling registration, documents must match NTA / MCC specifications (50–300 KB in PDF format).
Clear legibility of your Roll Number, Category designation, and Tehsildar seals is required to pass automated document verification.

faq.q: What is the size limit for NEET counseling category certificate?
faq.a: Category (OBC-NCL, EWS, SC, ST) and PwD certificates uploaded on mcc.nic.in must be PDF files sized between 50 KB and 300 KB.
